structured_output.title: Operator already sets global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole in values
structured_output.content: The environment's values set the key `global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole`, which v1.18.0 adds to disable HTTP-01 ACME challenges and drop cert-manager's permission to create pods. The release notes do not say what value is set or whether the key worked before v1.18.0. Inspect the value in your values file. If it is true, confirm that no Issuer or ClusterIssuer relies on HTTP-01 solvers, because those challenges would no longer have the permission they need. The environment summary lists only a Certificate and the certificates.cert-manager.io CRD, so it does not show which issuers or solver types are in use.
